cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get us all to work. You and your manager say the train's cancelled. Who gave you the same story?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The signal failed. It's on the departure board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take everyone to the board. They've got its operators keeping us away from our jobs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The fault covers three counties. I can arrange a bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Arrange it; I'll keep everyone together. Three counties don't shut down unless somebody wants our jobs.
